_note: DHT22 (AM2302) temperature/humidity sensor. Pin table per Aosong AM2302 datasheet. 3-pin module: VCC, DATA (single-wire), GND. White housing. Range: 0-100% RH (0.1% resolution), -40..80°C (0.1°C resolution). 16-bit values encoded ×10. Same single-wire protocol as DHT11 (40-bit frame), different byte encoding. Params: humidity (0..100, default 50), temperature (-40..80, default 25).
